mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 2 months indicates a broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO decline.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and rising), the Fed's policy rate hikes increase discount rates and reduce equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and rising.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior 3 months indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS has increased over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the annual inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may lead to aggressive monetary policy, increasing uncertainty and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annual inflation rate > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) over the prior 2 months indicates weakening economic activity across both supply and demand sides, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both INDPRO and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly growth in real GDP (GDPC1) over the prior 3 months indicates robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth is positive.
